text:
deploy-bot: Rolling out release artemis-2026-03. Feature flag 'model-route-v3' starting canary at 4% (internal-stable cohort). Pin model-version=llama-2-13b-q4a. Monitors: p50/p95/p99, 5xx, 429, kv_hit_rate. Change window: 01:30-04:30 UTC.
ava: Copy. I'll watch p99 and KV miss rate. Thresholds: p99 > 700ms OR 5xx > 0.4% => hold.
chris: Reminder: include the pinned model and rollback steps in release notes. And plan for a circuit-hold if multi-region degradation shows.
infra-bot: Canary deployed. model-route-v3 global=4%, region weights default; deployment id=artemis-canary-210.
sam: Seeing slight p99 drift in na-east at t+90s. No 5xx yet, kv_miss_rate +12%.
ava: Hold na-east to 0% to isolate. Command:
```
/deploybot ff set model-route-v3 --region na-east --percent 0 --reason "p99 drift, kv miss"
```
deploy-bot: Executed. na-east=0%; effective global ~3.2%. Pin remains.
chris: Lower global to 2% while we investigate tail. Also switch canary batching to conservative profile.
infra-bot: Batch profile changed: canary -> conserve-lowmem.
sam: After batching change, kv_miss_rate trending down, p99 stabilizing. No 5xx.
ava: We'll proceed with slow ramp plan documented here: 2% -> 6% -> 12% -> 25% with 10m holdpoints and region-specific holds. If any holdpoint fails, we execute rollback plan below.
release-manager: Rollback playbook (short): 1) /deploybot ff set model-route-v3 --global 0% 2) /deploybot ff unpin model-route-v3 3) route traffic back to stable tag 'stable-2026-02' 4) notify infra + blameless postmortem.
chris: Add note: if KV cold miss causes tail latency, run KV-priming job in target regions before next jump.
infra-bot: KV-priming job queued: job-id=kvprime-20260322-42.
sam: OK 15m observation passed at 6%. Proceed to 12% with 10m hold.
ava: Approving manual jump to 12%. I'll keep monitoring p95/p99.
infra-bot: Ramp executed. model-route-v3 global=12%.
release-manager: Updating release notes: "Canary pinned to llama-2-13b-q4a; staged regional holds available; rollback steps above; batch-profile conserve-lowmem applied for canary."
chris: Post-deploy action: schedule long-context perf run (2k tokens) against canary and run the KV warmup job again before next ramp to 25%.
ava: If any auto-alert triggers (p99 > 700ms OR 5xx > 0.4% OR kv_miss_rate > 15%) auto-hold + page oncall.
deploy-bot: Alert rules applied. 12m later: observation window green. Awaiting scheduled ramp to 25% per plan.
